faults.fault: When the prop is widened (image 3) the panel's middle is stretched, not extended: the button decals smear into elongated ovals and the 25c plate/text distorts. With spanx_center the centre of the panel must stay ONE size with only the ends extending.

When the prop is made taller (image 4) the count 'longer' rule stretches the coin door vertically — buttons become tall ovals and the panel grows down the cabinet. A coin door is one machine's one door; extra height belongs in the legs and lower cabinet, not in a stretched door.
At 1.5x wider and 1.6x taller the background/lower panel texture streaks into vertical smear bands below the coin door (images 3 and 4) — a repeat seam/stretch a player can point at.

wider_means: A wider pinball is a wider cabinet carcass - a broader backbox, playfield and body, but still one machine with one coin door.
taller_means: A taller pinball has longer legs and a taller lower cabinet below the playfield; the backbox and playfield stay the same size.
